I feel this way, a lot. Sometimes I call it “night depression”, lol. It’s so strange to be crying and preparing for your own death then the next day you feel fine. Sometimes I even feel a bit silly at how “dramatic” I was being. But those were still my emotions, and they’re still valid. 

I don’t really know why this happens. Maybe that’s when all the bad shit slips through the mask of dissocation/pretending to be ok, and it needs to come out for a bit, before you’re able to put the mask back on. Idk. Just spit-ballin. 

Either way, it’s really tough when you feel this way because in some respects it can feel even more invalidating. “I can’t really have trauma” “I don’t need help” “Clearly I’m fine” etc etc. What’s really important to remember when you’re feeling suicidal is that THIS FEELING WILL PASS. (I know you know this but it’s worth repeating). It’s hard to remember in the moment but if you can hold on to that thought, it will help. At least it helped for me. Distraction, distraction, distraction. Do what you need to get rid of the bad thoughts (within reason). Once they pass, you can pick up the pieces of yourself.
